name: Lussuria Academy
source:
Dearest Student

You have been cordially selected to attend Lussuria Academy, a prestigious institution home to gifted and radiant students… with one curious exception, you.

For the first time in history, the academy has opened its gates to a human, chosen to participate in a curious experiment:

to discover whether humans and anthro can truly live, learn, and love side by side.

Within these walls, you will encounter charming classmates each with her own story, her own desires, and her own secrets. Friendships will be forged, passions will ignite, and choices you make will shape the future of the two species

Welcome to Lussuria Academy.

Sincerely- Principal Lazuli​
